fields.name: ThrottleTimeMs
fields.about: The duration in milliseconds for which the request was throttled due to a quota violation, or zero if the request did not violate any quota.

fields.name: ErrorCode
fields.about: The message-level error code, 0 except for user authorization or infrastructure issues.

fields.name: ErrorMessage
fields.about: The message-level error message, if any.

fields.name: Results
fields.about: The results for descriptions, one per user.

fields.name: ErrorMessage
fields.about: The user-level error message, if any.

fields.name: CredentialInfos
fields.about: The mechanism and related information associated with the user's SCRAM credentials.

fields.name: Iterations
fields.about: The number of iterations used in the SCRAM credential.
